excerpt: Statsig is a unified platform for feature flags, A/B testing, and product analytics.
You can use any of these features on top of your own data warehouse through Warehouse Native with no extract, transform, and load (ETL).
Or, you can host your data in Statsig's infrastructure.
Feature Gates, commonly known as feature flags, allow you to toggle the behavior of your product in real time without deploying new code.
Dynamic configs replace hard-coded values in your application with JSON defined on the server.
Get data flowing into Statsig with only a few lines of code.
How to call checkGate in Statsig client and server SDKs to evaluate a feature gate, including parameters, return values, and exposure logging.
Create a new experiment in the Statsig console, including device-level, custom ID, and isolated experiments, then configure it on the Setup tab before you start it.
Statsig splits users into a control group and one or more test groups, serves each group a different variant, and reports metric lifts with confidence intervals.
Autotune and Autotune AI automatically weigh explore versus exploit to deliver the best-performing variant for a single metric.
Metrics Explorer is where you analyze your product data to understand how users interact with your product and to uncover ideas for new features.
You can switch between chart types from the top-left section of the interface while maintaining context on the selected events.
Overview of Statsig Web Analytics for tracking page views, autocapture events, conversions, and running A/B tests on your website.
Session Replay records users interacting with your website or product and lets you play back those sessions.
This approach is performant and space-efficient, with options to apply privacy filters to on-screen content.
Overview of Statsig Session Replay for capturing and replaying real user sessions to debug bugs, study UX, and investigate experiment anomalies.
Monitor and debug the health of your services directly inside Statsig
The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.
Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Overview of the Statsig HTTP API for retrieving feature gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logging events directly without an SDK.

A commenter who worked on an internal experimentation platform said Statsig built a stellar product, superior to competitors like Optimizely. Their team was impressed by how Statsig balanced dev velocity and statistical rigor, and noted 'These guys ship.'
One user has implemented Statsig at two companies as an alternative to LaunchDarkly and loved it both times.

One commenter found Statsig's landing page too vague to explain what the product does, citing lines like 'Turn action into insights and insights into action.' They guessed it was 'another analytics + A/B testing platform' and questioned whether it could be worth $1.1B.
